instruction: In GitKraken, create a new repository at ~/Documents/gk_branch_ui; add a file app.txt with the text "base", commit it, then create a branch named "feature/ui" from main and check out that branch.

verification.condition: Confirm that git -C ~/Documents/gk_branch_ui branch --list feature/ui returns the branch and git -C ~/Documents/gk_branch_ui rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD equals "feature/ui".
verification.expected_result: The branch "feature/ui" exists in ~/Documents/gk_branch_ui and is the current checked-out branch.
